question: Why did order volume spike on 24 November 2017?

change.metric: daily order count (count of orders per day using order_purchase_timestamp)

causes.summary: Product mix shifted toward higher-frequency categories on 24 Nov 2017.

statements.text: On 24 Nov 2017 the share of orders in the top 3 product categories was 0.2867 (28.67%), compared with a baseline of 0.2511 (25.11%) over 17-23 Nov 2017.
The relative increase was about 0.1418 (14.18%), supporting a mix shift toward higher-frequency categories.

evidence.finding: On 24 November 2017, the top 3 product categories accounted for 0.2867 (28.67%) of orders, versus a baseline of 0.2511 (25.11%) for 17–23 November 2017 — a rise of 0.0356 (3.56 percentage points), or about 14.18% relative to baseline.

next_checks: Verify category-level order counts to confirm which categories drove the mix shift.

causes.summary: A single seller generated a disproportionate number of orders on 24 Nov 2017.

statements.text: Seller 891071be6ba827b591264c90c2ae8a63 recorded 10 orders on 2017-11-24 against a baseline average of 0.1429 orders per day (17–23 November 2017), a 70.0x spike.

evidence.finding: Seller 891071be6ba827b591264c90c2ae8a63 recorded 10 orders on 2017-11-24 against a baseline average of 0.1429 orders per day (17–23 November 2017), a 70.0x spike.

next_checks: Assess whether this seller's orders account for a significant share of the total order count increase.

ruled_out.why: There were 0 duplicate order IDs on 24 Nov 2017 and 0 duplicates in the baseline, so duplicate records did not cause the spike.
The proportion of orders with a discount was 1.0 in both the 24 Nov window and the 17-23 Nov baseline, so a new promotional discount did not drive the spike.

limitations: The data cannot confirm whether the mix shift fully explains the 1,176 vs 136.571 order-volume spike.
Category-level order counts were not broken out, so the specific categories driving the mix shift are unidentified.
The single seller's 10 orders represent a small fraction of the total order count increase, limiting its explanatory power for the overall spike.
